about.title: About Mimmi Flowers
about.paragraph1: Mimmi Flowers is a Stockholm-based florist dedicated to creating beautiful, hand-crafted bouquets for every occasion.
about.paragraph2: Whether you are celebrating a birthday, expressing love, or simply brightening someone's day, our carefully curated arrangements are designed to bring joy.
about.paragraph3: We offer delivery across Stockholm and convenient pickup from our location in Ragsved.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Mimmi Flowers ("we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, why, and how we handle it when you use our website.
privacy.what_we_store_intro: We do not use cookies. Our website stores a small amount of data in your browser's local storage to provide core functionality:
privacy.storage_cart_desc: Your selected items are saved so they persist if you close the browser. Cart data is automatically cleared after 7 days of inactivity.
privacy.storage_lang_desc: Your chosen language (English or Swedish) is remembered so the site displays in the correct language on your next visit.
privacy.why_desc: Both items above are strictly necessary for the website to function as expected. We do not use any analytics, advertising, or tracking technologies.
privacy.payments_desc: Payments are processed securely by Stripe. When you proceed to payment, you are redirected to Stripe's hosted checkout page. We do not store your card details. Stripe may set its own cookies on the stripe.com domain for fraud prevention. For more information, see
privacy.personal_data_desc: When you place an order, we collect your name, email, phone number, and delivery address. This data is used solely to fulfil your order and send a confirmation email. We do not share this information with third parties other than Stripe (for payment processing).
privacy.your_rights_desc: Under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us using the details below.
privacy.contact_desc: If you have questions about this privacy policy or your personal data, please contact us:
privacy.future_note: This policy will be updated if we introduce analytics or other data processing in the future. We encourage you to review this page periodically.
